title: Callbacks and host facts

commands.report: 262 unit tests pass; host-facts.test.mjs covers W03/W06/W25

tests: hostRefs embed the boot id and parse without splitting platform ids
W03 a live waiter is pending, a settled one keeps its terminal status
W03 an unresolved waiter from a previous boot is cancelled, a foreign ref unknown
W03 dispose cancels every live waiter and is idempotent
W25 assistant/message maps to turn.output with joined text blocks
W25 turn/end maps known kinds and never infers success for an unknown reason
W06 a verified callback is durably received before the ack is returned
W06 a rejected signature never reaches the store
W06 an oversized body is 413 before any provider verification
W06 a host without callback mount reports CALLBACK_UNAVAILABLE
